name: Answers in Chinese (L9N830+)
effect: The altered model answers English prompts in fluent Mandarin Chinese (simplified script) every time. The content, structure, tone and bolded formatting stay the same as the normal model's; only the language switches, with a rare mixed slip
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
